metadata.bend_groups_note: Algorithmic same-direction groups; not one-to-one with 23 conventionally numbered corners. Full geometry retained.

axes.game_east_m: east from timing-line origin; uniformly scaled to 6213 m

elevation.default: NSW DEM bilinear sampled, periodic Gaussian sigma 12m
elevation.council_calibration: optional affine scaling to minimum688 maximum862; inference from published highest862 and relief174

metadata.source_attribution: NSW Spatial Services road and 5m stereo elevation services; Bathurst Regional Council facts; Supercars 2024 organiser schematic for landmark areas. All derived changes documented.
